description: This file defines an interface 'ErrorResponseAdapterProvider' for providing adapters for error responses in a protocol adapter context. It includes a generic method to retrieve an adapter handling a specific error response type.

classes.name: ErrorResponseAdapterProvider
classes.description: A generic interface that provides a method to obtain an adapter for error responses.

methods.name: getErrorResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns an adapter for the error response type E.
